Behind them a light-grey fabric sofa with yellow and cream cushions, a floor lamp at the left end of the sofa, a light-wood bookshelf with green plants and a doorway in soft focus; a low light-wood coffee table in front of the sofa. The woman stays on the left of the frame: long black hair with a center part, a plain beige to light-apricot knit home top and mid-blue jeans. The man stays on the right of the frame: clean short black hair, a plain light-grey crew-neck T-shirt and dark charcoal trousers. The camera stays on the coffee-table side facing the sofa and never crosses the line between them. The headphones and phone stay plain and unmarked, the phone screen faces away from the camera. Both speak at a normal-to-fast pace, picking up each other's lines instantly with no pauses and no lingering silence. No subtitles, captions, on-screen text, Chinese characters or watermark appear at any point.
